mentions.name: Deciduous
mentions.description: This tool provides a way of working with an LLM to track decision tree graphs, letting the model make more informed decisions and build its own logical chain for history keeping. It models all work as a DAG of events, goals, outcomes, decisions, and observations that network together, giving the user a living and recorded memory with ways to explore it. The site includes a short demo and a live graph of how the tool has built itself.
